title: Ben Johnson: We didn't get into this profession to be mediocre or average

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ben Johnson: We didn't get into this profession to be mediocre or average
sources.description: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said during his postgame press conference on Sunday that he "slept really well" on Saturday night because of how "on top of it" quarterback Caleb Williams was in their final meeting.
